One measurement, once.

Take it from a shirt you already own and like the fit of. Write the number down and you will never guess a size on this site again.

  1. Button a shirt you already own and like, and lay it face down and flat, sleeves out to the sides.
  2. Measure straight across from armhole to armhole — do not run the tape around your body.
  3. Type that number into the Fit Finder. We will show you only what we have on the shelf in your size.

Tolerance on every garment is ± 1 cm. Between two sizes, take the larger for office wear and the smaller for a weekend fit.

Size Chest, flat

Every product page carries its own table — these are the house averages. A relaxed linen shirt runs wider than a slim poplin at the same label.
